Native.name: PlayerAirborneGateCheck
Native.note: Checks if player should enter airborne state. Compares velocity +0x254 vs +0x258, calls PlayerXPHit check, if both pass sets byte +0xcf5=1 and ORs 0x20000 into +0x2f4 flags. Called from PlayerUpdate. 59 instructions.

Native.name: PlayerAnimationFinished
Native.note: Calls fcn.004f23d0 (check animation state), if zero calls fcn.00413c80 and returns signed byte from +0x6dc (animation ID). Returns 1 if animation system busy. 67 instructions.

Native.name: AirborneIntegrate_Revised
Native.note: REVISED: 694 instructions (not 183). Per-tick airborne physics. Applies gravity 84.741692/tick to +0x66c velocity, reads movement input flags at +0x1b8-0x1c4, adds air control via basis matrix at +0x78-0x94. No damping, no terminal velocity. Checks flag bit 4 at +0x2f4 for airborne gate.

Native.name: PlayerUpdate
Native.note: MAIN PER-TICK PLAYER UPDATE. 1480 instructions. Calls: AirborneGateCheck(0x408420), camera update(0x460cf0), view update(0x460ee0), check(0x46c060), WeaponState_Update(0x411000), WeaponCycler(0x40f760), WeaponStateMachine(0x4ec1e0) twice, animation state checks, ladder update(0x4113e0), system update(0x411770). This is the biggest player function.

Native.name: PlayerLocomotionSwitch
Native.signature: void PlayerLocomotionSwitch(void* player, int mode, int param);
Native.note: 13-case movement mode dispatcher (510 instructions). Cases: 1=walk, 2=run, 3=crouch/swim, 4=jump, 5=fall, 6=climb, 7=slide, 8=idle, etc. Calls respective sub-handlers via jump table at 0x40cf30.

Native.name: HeliTask_Register
Native.note: Registers 'Heli' task type with QTaskHashTable. 1096 instructions. Registers multiple callback functions: 0x431540 (update), 0x4316d0, 0x431ae0, 0x431b60, 0x432950, 0x432bb0, 0x432be0, 0x432bd0, 0x431b70. Sets task type ID at 0x53be58.

Native.name: VehiclePhysics_Wheels
Native.signature: void VehiclePhysics_Wheels(void* vehicle, int wheel_idx, int gear, int mode);
